# Curated real OpenTempl menu design documents

Source: https://github.com/noah-thing/opentempl
Source commit: `015064f1005e63563f73ebe0dfbeb84d90439bcc`
Original paths: `apps/editor/public/templates/<vibe>.json`
License: MIT (see `LICENSE`, preserved verbatim).
**Imported actual source page elements and layout geometry**, not color-only re-creations.
Source designs selected: 21 (list below). Files copied as curated design metadata, excluding source photo asset identifiers and executable code. The code renders only owners' own product imagery. Note: original layouts include food/wine/special/price-list themes which are adapted as café menus; expect some to have fewer item slots than ordinary full menus, requiring companion overflow pages.

- `food-menu-cafe-nord`: Cafe menu, rotated name (food-menu)
- `food-menu-checker-diner`: Diner menu poster (food-menu)
- `food-menu-noodle-bar`: Noodle bar menu, two pages (food-menu)
- `food-menu-colour-cards`: Menu in colour cards (food-menu)
- `food-menu-special-story`: Special of the day story (food-menu)
- `food-menu-wine-list`: Wine list, two pages (food-menu)
- `food-menu-drinks-blocks`: Drinks menu block grid (food-menu)
- `food-menu-lunch-week`: Weekly lunch board (food-menu)
- `food-menu-board-slide`: Digital menu board (food-menu)
- `asia-onigiri-label`: Rice ball menu card (asia-poster)
- `asia-izakaya-menu`: Izakaya menu (asia-poster)
- `brutalist-price-list`: Price list (brutalist)
- `stationery-arch-menu`: Dinner menu on cotton paper (fine-stationery)
- `hand-winelist-menu`: Scribbled wine list (hand-drawn)
- `jp-tea-menu`: Tea house menu, two pages (japanese-minimal)
- `pop-menu-bun`: Bakery menu (maximal-pop)
- `mid-century-cafe-menu`: Coffee bar menu (mid-century)
- `pixel-cafe-menu`: Cafe menu (pixel-bitmap)
- `receipt-price-list`: Price list on a receipt (receipt-utility)
- `seventies-diner-menu`: Diner menu (seventies)
- `pastel-cafe-menu`: Cafe menu, two pages (soft-pastel)

The owner-visible product values come from Supabase, not the original template's example business/dishes. Do not import or ship upstream demo photos. Copyright notice belongs with app distribution.
